**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The MFN rule is directional — it bites only where *we* would be obliged to give RadialSpark terms no less favourable than those given to third parties, or to match third-party offers.

- **§ 3 (Contractor's Compensation)** sets pricing purely by reference to each Statement of Work on a time-and-materials basis. There is no benchmarking, most-favoured-customer, or rate-matching construct.
- Full-document searches for "most favoured", "most favored", "favorable", "no less", and third-party comparison language returned nothing relevant; the agreement's only sections (§§ 1, 3–7) contain no MFN mechanic of any kind.

Because the preferred position is simply **no MFN obligation on the Customer**, the absence of such a clause is the outcome we want — so this is classified compliant rather than "missing," and no redline is appropriate.

Two points noted in the rationale rather than flagged:
- The agreement also gives us no MFN pricing *in our favour*. That would be welcome, but it is an upside ask, not a deviation under this rule.
- § 3(b) lets the Contractor "change rates with 30 days notice to Company." That is a genuine commercial concern, but it belongs to the pricing/uplift rules — flagging it here would double-count the same term across two rules.
